rationale.campaign_length: Z60前传与曾为Z60的V23后续任务构成长线战役。
rationale.colonization: 主线主要围绕现有国家和地区争夺，殖民不是核心。
rationale.complexity: 宗属、债务、阶层、正统性、教会力量和多阶段任务并行。
rationale.dark_story: 王朝伪史、恐惧政治、掠取与终局清洗危机贯穿后半程。
rationale.difficulty: 早期外交战争和后期正统性、任务要求及灾难均需管理。
rationale.diplomacy: 需与恶鬼、雄峡商盟和宗主国周旋，并整合不同附庸与亲族。
rationale.early_pressure: 开局受制于强邻，独立战争与资源筹措带来高压力。
rationale.magic_artifice_intensity: 噬道面具、教会力量和恶鬼交易是国家叙事及部分操作的核心。
rationale.narrative_density: 王后遗愿、雄氏谎言、北岭复兴与王朝崩塌连成完整故事。
rationale.tall_play: 山地古迹、首都和寺院重建重要，但并非纯建设路线。
rationale.trade_economy: 玉税、宦官财政、商盟与地区贸易服务战争和建设。
rationale.warfare: 独立、北岭统一、夺取烟州头衔和东洲扩张连续推动战争。

identity.appearance: 1444年北岭起始国；后续可按通用决议形成路终

successors.relationship: 北岭噬道国家通用形成；Z60出身者获得限定后续任务

national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text:
烟州西陲延绵百里的嶙峋山脉，异族称谓良多，但北岭诸部均称其为黑雾山，其层峦叠嶂构成天然迷阵，雾瘴盘桓如巨蟒缠缚西北边境。商贾行经此地，总对峰巅终年不散的玄雾帷帐指指点点，将猎猎风声附会成神魔呢喃。

然于北岭人眼中，这方险境实为淬炼数百年的血脉图腾。他们的先祖在雾海中雕琢出蛛网般的密道，能凭星斗偏移辨识幽谷方位，借山鹰盘旋预判外敌动向。峭壁间的藤索栈道暗藏十三道机括，云雾深处的采药人哨语可瞬息传遍九重山脊。

如今黑雾山早已不是单纯地理屏障，而是与北岭文明共生的活体甲胄。当游牧骑兵的弯刀劈开浓雾时，迎接他们的将是淬毒吹箭与滚木礌石——山民们笑称此为「黑雾的拥抱」。正如族老在《雾岭训诂》中所述，「我等非据守群山，而是化作了群山嶙峋的脊梁。」
description.text_en:
In the west of Yanshen there lies a mountain range that goes by many names, but its people know it as the Black Mist Hills, a colossal labyrinth of mountains and valleys that stretches along almost the entire northwestern border of Yanshen. It has been the source of many legends told by outsiders who look upon these hills and see the mystical veil of fog that adorns them.
But to the Beiklings they have become home, for centuries they have inhabited these hills and have learned to traverse the many mountains and ravines that are hidden within the mist. To the people that have chosen to live in this land it is a natural bastion and the greatest advantage the Beiklings have against any foreign force seeking their demise.

description.text:
蹴桥之地承长生阁天威一百年，虽得荫蔽，亦需岁纳「玉税」——此乃取意于议会所在之禁城的碧阶典故。为填永无餍足的贡箱，蹴桥诸侯终日策马穿行于峡谷茶驿之间，羊皮账册上既有治下黎庶的赋税，亦有借道流寇缴纳的买路钱。

深山集市常见这般景象：绛袍税吏以铁尺丈量走私商队的货箱，转身又将淬毒匕首抵在劫掠者的咽喉。戍卫们戏称此等营生为「双锋秤」，左边称的是稻黍布帛，右边量的是血债罪愆。就连王帐金顶的银铃，每响一声都伴着游牧部落献上的赎罪金铢。

数百年铁索横江的征赋术，终使蹴桥淬炼出举世罕有的理财经。当最后一批铜钱封入镌刻鹰纹的贡箱时，执政权杖已悄然化作点石成金的魔杖——诸侯们甚至能从旱魃肆虐的焦土里榨出税银，用流民褴褛的衣衫织就锦衣卫的新袍。税官常说：「长生殿取走玉石，我等便教顽石生出玉脉。」
description.text_en:
Tsukqiao has been a subject of the Eternal Council for almost 100 years now, and although this has allowed them to survive, it also came with a cost. Their overlords demand their tribute, the so-called 'Jade Tax' in reference to the Shirgrii serving as the seat of the council.
To be able to afford said tribute the rulers of Tsukqiao have to spend a great deal of time moving around their lands, collecting taxes from every subject as well as the raiders using their lands as a secure base. It is thus not rare to see the members of the dynasty roaming around the hills and valleys, visiting every settlement in an effort to meet the quota.
This has over the years allowed Tsukqiao to pay the onerous tribute and even produce a surplus big enough to fund the activities of their rulers.

description.text:
我族与噬道的渊源由来已久。
自玄君初戴千相之面那日始，我族便与魇蚀术结下了不解之缘。昔年，凭此诸多诡谲秘技，北岭先民得以纵横烟州，然诸法之中犹以我族「幻面仪典」最负恶名。
以「气」为引，经血祭淬炼而成的面具，可惑敌心神于无形。佩戴者五识通明，剑戟之术倍增锋芒。更有战士声称甲胄附有古战魂，会在金铁交鸣时耳语破敌之策。
霸权荣光虽已化作斑驳暗影，此术却在蹴桥遗民中薪火不灭。而今当宿敌再度叩关，雾瘴深处传出的，依旧是铁面叩击颅骨的铮鸣——正如《诡道注疏》所载：「千相非甲，乃噬道赋予我等的第二层皮肤。」
description.text_en:
Our history with the Devouring Path is a long one.
Since the day the Black King donned the Mask of Many Faces for the first time we as a people have been connected to the dark arts in many ways. We have learned and made use of many sinister techniques that have allowed our people to dominate Yanshen in times long gone, but little compares to one of our most infamous techniques.
Through the infusion of chi during a ritual, one is able to create masks with the ability to alter the enemy’s perception of themselves and provide the wearer with enhanced perception and combat skills, some warriors even claim their masks would speak to them and offer them guidance in battle.
Our time of domination is but a distant shadowy memory, but this technique survives amongst the people of Tsukqiao, and it continues to give us an advantage when fighting our enemies once more.

description.text:
凡涉噬道者，必染赤鬼业障。山中鬼众于此禁忌之道浸淫千年，雕琢禁途臻于完美，自其道法在北岭人族间兴起伊始，其所思所想便如鸠毒般渗入教义——而今丘壑生民趋之若鹜，癫狂竟作悟道幡。
然群魔所授非尽断灭法。噬道实乃通天鬼牖，启封黄泉宗卷，通禁忌法门，实可谓妙用无穷。若善加操弄，禁忌知识亦可为蹴桥铸革新刃，斩九窍痼疾，革故鼎新。
但凡密咒真言、禁术残卷，纵使承负万钧因果，亦当噬骨饮鸩以求——须知低地膏腴之徒占尽天时地利，吾辈不入炼狱取修罗诡智，怎敌其手？
description.text_en:
One cannot follow the Devouring Path without feeling the influence of the Oni, they have molded and perfected the arts of the forbidden path, and ever since the Path has risen in popularity amongst the human inhabitants of the hills their ways of thinking have come as part of the teachings.
But not all techniques the demons of the hills teach are of a destructive nature, the devouring path opens many doors to prohibited knowledge, some of which may give us an advantage if we seek to reform Tsukqiao away from its most dysfunctional aspects.
Whatever uttered word of power or scraps of proscribed writing can help us learn new ways and give us an advantage against the people of the lowlands, far wealthier and more established than our mountain realm, is worth the price.

description.text:
北岭故土曾为千山焰痕交错之地。
崖壁上林立的锻造坊昼夜不息，为怖朝掠骑锻铸征伐四方的武器和盔甲。
而今万点锻火多已熄灭，宏伟的锻造厂们或坍为焦墟，或沦为鸦巢，其巨大阴影投射这片土地上。唯余几处倔强火种仍在暮色中跃动——那是自诩「炉裔」的守炉者们，用风箱呜咽复活着古老焚铁纪年的记忆。
坐落于群山间的蹴桥有着当世最著名的锻坊之一，将从大山深处开采的矿石源源不断地铸造成武器，供我们的部队和掠骑使用。
description.text_en:
The Beikling homeland once was one lit up by myriad fires.
Across the hillside many forges would ceaselessly produce the weapons and armors for the raiders of the Terror Empire to use on their campaigns of pillaging.
Little remains of those times, most of the greatest forges of the land have long been destroyed or fallen into disuse, plunging the land into shadows. But some remain and continue to see use by locals who keep the long lasting memory of the forgemasters of yore alive.
Tiaochi possesses one of the most notorious forges of the current era, which takes the ore mined from the mountain depths and molds them into weapons for our armies and raiders.

name.text_en: In the Shadows of the Giants

description.text:
勋王朝的历史难以考究，关于其起源与发展的记载寥寥无几，而现存的文献更是……令人难以置信。
据官方记载，勋解夫在贾赫政权崩溃后建立了蹴桥；他是岚丘总督之孙，父亲是当地驻军的将军。文献还进一步指出，其是旧帝国最后一位国王的后裔，称费氏王朝的最后一位成员在王朝灭亡后幸存下来，其后裔便是勋氏一族。据称勋解夫在找到「权力之面」后，正是通过这件神物启示，方知晓自己身负皇家血统。

这般传说令世人难以信服，但对勋王朝的王室而言，它就像他们统治的群山一样真实。他们尊解夫为分裂时代实现统一、带来团结的伟大征服者，并坚信重聚「众相之面」、建立新北岭帝国乃是与生俱来的天命。
description.text_en:
The history of the Xion dynasty is difficult to study, for there are very few accounts about their origins or history, and what is there to be found is … hard to believe.
As the official story goes, it was Jiefu Xion who founded Tsukqiao after the fall of the Jaherian administration; he was the grandson of a governor from Lanqiu and his father was a general stationed at the local garrison. The story then goes on to claim that he was a descendant from the last king of the old empire, claiming that the last member of the Fei dynasty did in fact survive after the fall of their dynasty and his family would come to be known as the Xion. It was supposedly Jiefu himself who, after finding the Mask of Might, received a revelation about his royal origins from the mask.

This tale strains the credulity of most people, but to the members of the Xion Dynasty it is a truth as real as the mountains they rule over. They honor Jiefu as a great conqueror who brought unity in a time of division and they believe it is their birthright to reunite the Mask of Many Faces and proclaim a new Beikling empire.

description.text:
在虎人尚未踏足烟州之前，我辈诸族曾统御于大路终帝国帜下，此肆虐烟河诸域之强国，凭遍山雾炉滋养铁骑，以覆面劫掠者令四方胆寒。我们的战车碾平万千聚落，将俘民献祭于维系黑暗仪式的熔炉——这一切皆是为侍奉配戴「众相之面」的伟大统治者，此等圣物正是我族无上力量和荣耀的象征。
然而当支离破碎、群龙无首的路终国遭遇诃利秣大军压境，这辉煌时代终告终结。侵略者焚毁诸城、筑垒屯兵，誓要将我族永恒践踏于铁蹄之下。

如今诃利秣早已化作枯骨，烟州之地支离破碎，而圣面具碎片重归我族之手——是时候让怖朝再度君临天下。
description.text_en:
Long before the tigerfolk stalked into Yanshen, we were united under the empire of Great Luzhong, a mighty realm that ravaged much of the Yanhe river lands, striking terror with masked raiders and armies fueled by the grand forges that gleamed all over the misty hills, razing countless settlements to the ground and abducting their inhabitants to serve as fuel for dark rituals, all to serve the great rulers who wore the Mask of Many Faces, a symbol of our immense power and glory.
This glorious era ultimately came to an end, when a broken and leaderless Luzhong fell to the invasion of Harimar, their warriors destroying our cities and establishing strongholds to ensure we would forever stay beneath their heel.

Now, with Harimar long dead, Yanshen fractured and all the fragments of the great mask once more in possession of our people, it is time for the Terror Empire to rise again.

description.text:
自路终国陨于诃利秣之爪，北岭人的国度已沉寂太久，太久了——久到这片土地上再无人敬畏北岭之名，久到北岭再无一个能越过自己的国界，向外界输出秩序和律法的强权。

年复一年，我们苟活于异族铁蹄之下，疆土分裂，诸民受制于异邦强权。唯一崛起的机缘，竟是在无能怯懦王朝治下的昙花一现，转眼又沦为遥远国度的新征服者的战利品。

万幸，这样的日子终于到头了。

古老面具已然重铸，我们的子民已经团聚，帝国的旌旗正在故土山巅猎猎招展。

一千五百年来，伟大的头衔首次由有资格的人取得——那命中注定要统御全北岭的天选之人。

昭告天下——吾等不再会让荣耀蒙尘。
description.text_en:
It has been too long since a Beikling state held power. Too long since a Beikling was respected and feared across the land; too long since we Beiklings had a realm that could rule and exert law even outside our borders, one that we could truly be proud of.

It has been too long since Luzhong fell to Harimar.

For years we have lived under the boot of foreign kings, ruled by external powers and divided across our land. The only time we managed to rise was under the rule of an unworthy dynasty of weak cowards, just for us to fall in turn to a new conqueror from lands far beyond.

No more.

The Masks have been reforged, our people have been reunited, the banners of the empire fly proud over the mountains of our homeland.

For the first time in fifteen hundred years, the great title has been claimed by someone worthy, one destined to be ruler of all Beiklings.

Let it be known; we will not fail again.

description.text:
烟州的迷雾山脉自成一域，白雾噬骨，幽径吞魂，其近乎虚无缥缈的性质，成为许多传说和恐怖故事的源头，乡野怪谈谓其为鬼魅之巢。许多曾试图穿越此险地之人或不幸丧生，或迷失于那错综复杂的山道之中，然于我辈而言，这飘渺凶岭却如神女广袖，将南朝狼烟与北地战蹄尽数阻于雾海之外。

列国视雾丘如烫手山芋——多少光阴里，进犯诸侯的旌旗在此锈蚀，异国税吏的算盘珠散落崖底。此般诸地，非有利图，不可服之。正是这千嶂迷宫，孕养出举世闻名的「雾山骑阵」。当山风捎来铜钱与文牒的气息，吾辈的长刀便于月圆之夜苏醒，将先祖「以劫止戈」的生存之道刻进峭壁苔痕。

如今新帝銮驾东归，是时候为雾山诸部系上魂铃了。当神岩壁画被重新勾勒王纹，当谷地长老的占星仪对准王辰，蛰伏千年的雾丘子民终于能沿着玉阶稽首——这次跪拜的，不再是残破的旌节。吾民自豪地向他们的正统之君鞠躬，因为他们知道，千年后的此刻，破碎的帝冠终于又迎来了新的继业者。

凶兽虽难臣服，却能学会不再噬主。只需在再次喂食时，不忘割裂那断饲者的咽喉。
description.text_en:
The Mist Hills of Yanshen are a beast of their own, the source of many tales and horror stories due to their almost ethereal nature. Many people have died trying to navigate their treacherous terrain or from getting lost in their labyrinthine passes, but to us the Hills are a safe haven, a homeland far away from the grasp of the withering warmongers of the south.

To these lesser realms, our region is almost impossible to rule; our people have a long history of fighting off interlopers, keeping them at bay and only submitting under favorable terms. It's from these heights that our people launch our infamous raids, keeping the traditions of old alive.

With the return of the Empire, we can now begin to reclaim our rightful rule of the hills that saw our birth, extending our authority to the many autonomous communities that live in the valleys at their flank. Our people bow to their rightful ruler with pride, knowing the broken title has a new claimant after millennia.

The beast does not bow, but it can be taught not to bite the hand it feeds it.

description.text:
低地烟人唤我等为「妖人」，恶魔之民。千百年来，我们始终是其最深的梦魇、至大之恐惧——北岭战士曾踏破山河，所过之处洗劫无算，财富尽掠之余只留下遍地哀鸿。他们将掳掠的农人献予帝国仪典，赋予我军无穷神力，延续这死亡的循环。

纵使伟大国度陨落，我们依旧无愧「妖人」之名。铁蹄频叩关河，焚掠烟地无休，令其永世笼罩在北岭的阴云之下。

而今帝国归来，先王座下那遮天蔽日的劫掠铁骑，将重现人间。且看铁蹄踏碎烟州山川之时，他们必会记起——这诨号，究是我等以血以火，一笔一画，如何写来。
description.text_en:
The Yan of the lowlands call us 'Yaoren', the Demon Men. For hundreds of years we were their greatest fear - our warriors ravaged and pillaged much of the land, carrying away untold riches and leaving despair and devastation in their wake. We fed their captured peasants to the rituals of our Empire, granting our armies untold powers to continue this deadly cycle.

Even after the fall of the great realm, our people continued to live up to the Yaoren title, terrorising the Yan people and leaving them in constant dread of our raids.

With the return of the Empire, we can once more organize great raider hosts of the kind the old kings used to command. With them, we will remind the Yanshen exactly how we earned our nickname.

description.text:
彼时洪荒未远，龙汉初劫，一桩几乎湮没在时光尘埃中的密契，注定了我族万世不拔之基。

鬼族特使负神物出山，九重宫阙谒见旧路终之绯王——彼时王朝不过是东洲万邦中笃信凡俗之道的寻常尔邦。

使者献上的「众相之面」惊绝人寰：四张鎏金诡面环抱寰宇奇石，紫气萦绕如活物吞吐。绯王自见此物，竟终日不肯除面，不出一年便形销骨立。其子继位时悍然弃置传国金面，执意佩此邪器登极，冕为路终国第一位噬道之王，史称「红王绯」，自此我族与噬道魇蚀术因缘纠葛千百春秋。

四张古面真义俱已斑驳难考，今人解之为：
力之具相，可掌山河枢机；
财之丰腴，当证盛世华章；
御心摄魄，敕令万民臣服；
天命所归，端王具相，独踞龙庭。

此四樽神面铭我北岭美德。纵使屠尽千里血河，化作修罗踏骸而歌，也定要教这北地之盟永世长存。
description.text_en:
Many years ago, in a period almost lost to history, there was an exchange that would seal our destiny forever.

A delegate Oni was sent down the mountains to make an offer to the then Fei King of Old Luzhong, a realm that up to that point was just another follower of the common folklore of Haless.

The Oni brought with him a tribute, a mask like no other. Composed of 4 smaller masks bound by a central gem, the Mask of Many Faces was a sight to be beholden. It enraptured our ruler, who refused to take the mask off, and in the span of a year he would come to wither away. His son, who would come to be known as 'The Red King Fei', wore the mask to his enthronement, rejecting the old ceremonial one used until then. He would come to be the first Devouring Path King of Luzhong, beginning our people’s long association with the dark arts.

The original meaning of each Mask has been lost for many years, but as we understand it today they are:
Might, the power to rule.
Wealth, a sign of prosperity.
Control, of oneself and of others.
And Right, to sit on the throne and wear the mask.

These are the virtues of the Beikling People, and we will inflict the terror of a thousand deaths on our enemies if it means protecting the union.

description.text:
烟州山脉的褶皱深处盘踞着蛰伏万古的磅礴伟力。于我北岭民而言，这地脉真髓比琼浆玉露更为甘甜——它既是社稷运转的机枢，也曾是决胜沙场的秘钥，更是劫掠铁骑至今令诸国闻风丧胆的终由——此力名曰玄铁。

雾丘之地承载着东洲最壮阔的矿脉洪流。忆往昔岁月，我们锻玄铁为修罗骨，淬寒锋作断魂芒——鼎盛之年，北岭故土的丘壑间不尽熔炉映红天幕，千山焰痕交错，星火缀野竟似银河倒悬。其中银盛雾炉更是撑起了路终霸业的脊梁，浸透巫祝之力的魔兵，自其幽瞑锻台降世，昼锻血镰，夜铸鸩甲，在锻兵之艺上屡屡创新，可谓路终之灯塔。

自那煌煌冶世湮灭于劫灰，雾丘久沐寒夜。然帝国既已重生，千山雾炉必将重燃真火。且看玄铁洪流再漫过那烟岭峰峦，吾辈定要从往昔余烬中——锻出照破长夜之新日，照亮直抵不庸质疑权力之新途。
description.text_en:
Deep beneath the mountains of Yanshen, there is a power that awaits control. To we Beiklings, it is as vital to life as food or water, and it is central to the functioning of our society. It played a key role in giving us an advantage in battle in times past, and to this day remains the reason why our raiders are as fearful and dangerous as they are. That power is ore.

The Mist Hills are home to some of the biggest veins of metals in Haless. In the past we learned to use these metals to forge the weapons of war our warriors used to fight our enemies; at our height, the hillsides of the Beikling homeland resembled the night sky, lit by hundreds of forges that produced all the goods our armies and raiders needed. Amongst these, the forge of Yinsheng was the very greatest, standing as the beacon of Luzhong’s power and responsible for many innovations in the creation of weaponry.

Long years have passed since this era of light came to an end, and darkness has enveloped the Mist Hills, but with the return of the Empire this era must be reborn too. The rekindled fires of a thousand forges shall brighten our path to absolute power once more, the might of our homeland reforged from the ashes of what once was.

description.text:
北岭群岳之巅矗立着冢冢圣墟，每座圣墟皆以孤峰绝寺镇守天枢，其地脉玄奥可通九幽——我们在那里与烟州诸邦讳莫如深的禁忌共舞，将先人遗蜕托付峰峦，令其魂归墟冥，更于庙宇祭坛行不可言之祀仪。

初代圣山乃赤鬼为「红王绯」所筑往生冢，为其陵墓。圣墟后渐成路终帝国鼎盛时的万民祝祭之所。汊津寺当属其中最负盛名者，亦是现存为数不多的圣墟庙宇——这座在研习黑暗教义者心中具有极强通灵联系的圣地，曾上演过那个年代最残暴的祭祀仪式。

而今我们仍在重铸圣墟荣光。每座新冢的落成，都会令方圆百里的氏族争相献上族中精锐作其护法。那萦绕在荒岭间的法铃，每一声都在昭告天下：当最后一缕香火攀上参星，神龛基座上将垒起新的累累白骨。
description.text_en:
The Sheng Shan are the holiest mounds in our lands; each is crowned by an isolated monastery, the remote location of which is intended to bring the monks to closer contact with the spirits that flit around our homeland. We commune with forces seen as taboo by the rest of Yanshen there, bury our dead so they may join them upon their peaks, and perform dark rites within the temples.

The first Sheng Shan was built by the Oni as a tomb for the Red King. They became iconic of the early and middle Imperial Era of Luzhong as great centers of religion amongst the common folk. The most famous of them and one of the few that remains is the temple of Chatzin. A place deemed of great spiritual connection amongst those who follow the dark teachings, it was the home of some of the most brutal rituals done during this time.

Even in the present we continue to build Sheng Shan mounds, and taking care of them is a matter of prestige for the communities that live nearby.

description.text:
巍巍路终，九死还魂；煌煌路终，万劫不湮。

山河永固不可摧，休教异族执权柄。

天不许，地不允。

帝国自遗落深山攀援而生，千万劫灰淬炼终获新生——那些被苍生摒弃时坠落的血泪，早已在黄泉奈落凝成恶业结晶。

这幽瞑浇筑的惊怖王朝，注定要以獠牙衔仇敌骨，以铁腕铸铁血律。

铁骑霜刃掠境时，他们的惊怖如其先祖；幽冥鬼火临城时，他们的战栗译似尔昔年；那绵延千百载的惶惶长夜，合该轮转至尔辈檐下回响。

且让寰世重忆——血海深仇必如数奉还，先民叩首应世代重演，北岭威名当刻作永世心魇。

千春万劫，路终不倾。
description.text_en:
Luzhong is again, Luzhong shall be forever.

The realm shall not break again; no external power shall rule the Beiklings anymore.

We will not allow it.

We have been reforged, rebirthed from the hatred of a people who have cried one too many tears over the world who is choosing to forget they even exist.

Our state, our Empire of Terror, shall be the one to rule - and we will do so with an iron fist, one of retribution and vengeance.

They shall know dread like their ancestors did. They shall tremble when hearing of our arrival. They shall live in terror just as we did all the long centuries after our fall.

They shall learn to fear our name once more.

Eternal and evermore, Luzhong will not fall again.
